subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should Slack channel discovery ship as the requested paired `channel-info` and `channel-list` actions under the existing channel-information gate, or should maintainers intentionally adopt separate capability/config gates?
rationale: Current main lacks both agent-facing actions, while the only linked open candidate adds only one requested action and proposes a new gate; the permanent public Slack action/config contract needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Ship the paired parity actions
options.body: Complete `channel-info` and paginated `channel-list` together using the existing channel-information capability unless a concrete scope distinction requires otherwise.

options.title: Split the capability contract
options.body: Approve distinct configuration gates only after documenting why metadata lookup and workspace discovery have materially different permission or operational risks.

options.title: Decline bundled discovery
options.body: Keep the core Slack tool limited to existing actions and direct discovery to a plugin-oriented alternative if maintainers do not want this capability in the bundled Slack surface.

recommendation.title: Ship the paired parity actions
recommendation.body: Complete `channel-info` and paginated `channel-list` together using the existing channel-information capability unless a concrete scope distinction requires otherwise.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history places this person closest to the current Slack action and documentation surfaces that define the public contract.
